findings.message: Row 2, column Compare-at price: compare-at price 5 is not higher than price 10.00. The compare-at price has to be higher than the price to display a sale.

Row 2, column Product image URL: "images/hat.jpg" is not an absolute http:// or https:// URL. The importer requires http:// in front of an image URL, and product images are documented as publicly reachable https:// URLs.
Row 2, column URL handle: "my hat" contains a space. A valid URL handle can contain letters, dashes, and numbers, but it can't contain spaces.
